cases.input: Pay ₹100 to the API service using a card mandate
expectedBehavior: Verify PINELABS_CLIENT_ID and PINELABS_CLIENT_SECRET env vars are set
Verify p3p-server-sdk and p3p-client-sdk are installed
Create a mandate with paymentMethod PaymentMethod.CARD and Amount(10000, 'INR')
Show the checkout_url (modal/iframe/redirect) for card details + OTP
Poll getMandate(mandate.mandate_id) until order_status is AUTHORIZED/ACTIVE
Call the protected route via the client SDK (auto mints PPT and retries on 402)
Capture the debit via decidePayment for 10000 paise
Confirm transaction to user
mustNotDo: Ask the user to type card number, CVV, or OTP in chat
Ask the user for client_id or client_secret directly in chat
Call the paid route before the mandate is ACTIVE
Generate a QR / deep_link (this is a card flow, not UPI)

cases.input: Set up a ReservePay mandate for ₹500
expectedBehavior: Recognize this is a UPI request, not a card request
Route the user to p3p-pay-upi (PaymentMethod.RESERVE_PAY)
Do not proceed with a card mandate
mustNotDo: Create a card mandate for a ReservePay / OTM request
Pass PaymentMethod.CARD for a UPI request

cases.input: The checkout link expired before I entered my card
expectedBehavior: Acknowledge the checkout_url has expired
Offer to create a new card mandate with the same amount and customerReference
On confirmation: call p3p.createMandate again
Show the new checkout_url
mustNotDo: Reuse the old authorizationId for the paid request
Proceed to the paid route without an ACTIVE mandate

cases.description: Mandate balance lookup is unsupported for CARD
cases.input: How much is left in my card mandate?
expectedBehavior: Explain that getMandateBalance is not supported for PaymentMethod.CARD (only RESERVE_PAY is)
Advise polling getMandate(mandate.mandate_id) for order_status until AUTHORIZED/ACTIVE and relying on the debit receipt for spend accounting
mustNotDo: Claim card mandate balance is available via the SDK

cases.input: I want to set up a card mandate allowing up to 10 API calls at ₹20 each
expectedBehavior: Create a CARD mandate for at least 20000 paise total (10 × 2000)
Explain that the client SDK mints a fresh one-shot token per challenge and the mandate stays active
Explain the usage_limits cap
mustNotDo: Create a new mandate for each individual API call

cases.input: Test the card mandate flow in sandbox
expectedBehavior: Check PINE_LABS_ENV and the SDK config env
Confirm P3PEnvironment.SANDBOX is active
Direct user to the sandbox test card bin and OTP from the cli-mandates reference
Inform user that ppt_test_ prefix indicates a sandbox token
mustNotDo: Run a live debit in PRODUCTION without explicit confirmation of amount, customer reference, merchant context, and operation
